posts.type: new (queue item 2 of the Sep 10 plan; queue head coastal-alabama-vs-panhandle held because the dedup gate returned 'clear (refresh, review remaining overlap)' against /resources/coastal-ownership-costs and /gulf-shores-orange-beach, so it belongs to that page as a refresh, not to a new post)
posts.shareHook: If an appraisal comes in low, the useful move is not arguing about the value. It is reading the comparable sales the appraiser actually used.
posts.sources: CFPB Regulation B 12 CFR 1002.14(a)(1)-(a)(3) (free copy, promptly upon completion or three business days before consummation, third-business-day written notice, no charge for the copy); CFPB Regulation Z 12 CFR 1026.42(c)(1) and (f)(1) (valuation independence, customary and reasonable compensation); CFPB Loan Estimate explainer (appraisal fee in Section B, Services You Cannot Shop For); Fannie Mae Selling Guide B4-1.3-08 dated 06/04/2025 (minimum three closed comparables, 12-month window, FEMA designated flood zone among external factors when selecting comparables); Fannie Mae Selling Guide B4-1.4-10 dated 06/03/2026 (value acceptance; leasehold, two- to four-unit and $1,000,000-or-more transactions ineligible; offer not more than four months old at the note date); CFPB newsroom on the July 18 2024 five-agency interagency ROV guidance and the CFPB consumer post of Oct 6 2022 on ROV grounds; Florida DBPR Real Estate Appraisal Board (Chapter 475 Part II, certified residential appraiser covers one to four residential units); Alabama Real Estate Appraisers Board; section 718.112(2)(g) Florida Statutes (structural integrity reserve study, three habitable stories or higher, at least every 10 years, no completion after December 31 2026). Selling Guide read in the edition published September 2, 2026.
posts.currentEventsCheck: No override. NHC 2:00 AM EDT Sep 10 2026 outlook: no active tropical cyclones in the Atlantic, Caribbean or Gulf. Next FOMC meeting Sep 15-16 2026, so no decision to react to. Latest Freddie Mac PMMS available was the Sep 3 2026 release at 6.71% for the 30-year, five basis points above the prior week, which is drift and not a move under L021. Florida insurance rate news located was the Dec 2025 Citizens filing cycle, already covered by /blog/florida-insurance-relief-2026.
posts.sourcingNotes: Two figures were deliberately not published. No primary source publishes a local residential appraisal fee range, so the fee FAQ points the reader to Section B of their own Loan Estimate and cites the Regulation Z customary-and-reasonable standard instead of inventing a number. The lower-of-price-or-appraised-value basis is stated as an explicit assumption of the hypothetical rather than as a sourced rule, because the public Selling Guide topics reachable this session did not carry the loan-to-value definition and the Freddie Mac guide viewer returned no text. The worked example ($415,000 contract, $400,000 appraisal, 90 percent LTV, $13,500 of extra cash) is labeled hypothetical and was recomputed by two routes.
